thread:
keith: hey finance — quick one from last night's client dinner in Dublin. I put the meal on the corp card (last4 7788) but the server added a 25% auto-gratuity after we left. receipt I saved shows subtotal EUR 220, handwritten note shows tip EUR 55 but card posted EUR 275 total. Client insists they paid tip in cash. what do we do?

maya: do you have the itemized restaurant receipt + client confirmation? if the card shows the tip posted we normally reimburse the card charge but if client paid in cash we need a short attestation from them to avoid double billing.

keith: uploaded the receipt to Ramp (expense: DUB-client-dinner-2026-05-14). receipt PDF shows subtotal and a handwritten tip line EUR 55; no separate card slip. client (sophie) DM'd me saying she paid EUR 55 in cash to the server.

expense-bot: Reminder: attach (1) itemized receipt, (2) client attestation (DM or email), and (3) Ramp txn screenshot for card charge. Expenses with third-party reimbursements require client confirmation to avoid duplicate charges.

maya: thanks. two options: 1) if client confirms in writing we will reimburse the full posted card amount and then ask you to reimburse the company EUR 55 (or we can offset in next expense) OR 2) if client confirmation is formal (email) we can treat it as third-party payment and only reimburse the net meal amount. Preference?

keith: client sent an email: "I paid the tip in cash to the server at the time. Please deduct tip from your company card charge." I uploaded the email.

roger: cc'ing manager approval — I approve adjusting reimbursement to net meal (EUR 220) since client attests cash tip. keith, add a one-line note in the expense saying "client paid tip in cash, attached email from Sophie".

maya: got it. will mark expense as "client-covered tip" and process reimbursement for EUR 220. Also filing a vendor follow-up: restaurants should produce a signed card slip when adding tip post-bill.

card-ops: quick note: if the restaurant later disputes and issues a chargeback, we may need the card slip to fight it. please keep the client email and receipt in the expense. We'll monitor the Ramp txn (RMP-TXN-77881234).

keith: added the note and the email. thanks all. Sophie — thanks for sending the email quickly.

sophie: no problem! glad we clarified.

expense-bot: Expense status updated: "Docs received  client attestation  processed net reimbursement". Expected reimbursement to Keith: EUR 220.

maya: done, payment routed to your bank in 3-5 business days. closing thread unless card-ops flags chargeback risk.

keith: perfect, thank you.
